test(render-cache): a compile keeps nothing of a render is asserted from a heap snapshot's strong paths, not from collection (#581)

* test(render-cache): the compile-keeps-nothing case polls collection over turns, and its quarantine line goes (brandon-unfiled-3248.na7i)

* test(render-cache): a still-held store in the compile-keeps-nothing case is named by its path from the heap's roots (brandon-unfiled-3248.na7i)

* test(render-cache): a compile keeps nothing of a render is asserted from a heap snapshot's strong paths, not from collection (brandon-unfiled-3248.na7i)

Collection is the wrong observable: gc() is synchronous, so a count of gc() calls or turns neither explains the CI failure nor tells a holder that lets go later from one that never does. The case now asserts no strong path from the heap's roots reaches a ProbeStore, and a failure prints the path. heap-retainers.mjs gains --strong so a WeakRef's edge is never named as the holder; the helper wraps that tool instead of reading snapshots itself.

* test(render-cache): the held control shares the case's snapshot and class, and heap-retainers traces until its limit is met of paths (brandon-unfiled-3248.na7i)

A control of another class left the case's empty answer unproven for ProbeStore itself, and a second snapshot cost the file seconds. One held ProbeStore is now the path the single snapshot must show. heap-retainers sliced its targets to the limit before tracing them, so under --strong a weak-only target used up the limit and an empty answer meant 'the first few were not held'.

docs(design): the isolated daemon, tmux events and browser surface designs

Goals, architecture, contracts and one document per area, with the surveys and probes behind them. The Frame is recorded as built, and the browser surface is un-parked.
fix(bar-pane): a frame overwrites its rows and lands whole, so the pane stops flickering
